units.title: Exercise physiology: energy systems, intensity and adaptation
learning_outcomes: explain at a broad level how ATP supplies immediate cellular energy
compare the overlapping roles of phosphagen, glycolytic and oxidative energy pathways without treating them as isolated switches
interpret how intensity and duration influence perceived effort, breathing and recovery
distinguish an acute response from a training adaptation
identify why individual measurements and wearable estimates have limitations

assessment.suggested_threshold: 11/15; safety-critical conditions must all be met
critical_fail_conditions: unsafe practice or bypassed stop rule
privacy, consent or copyright violation
unsupported diagnostic/causal claim
fabricated source or misrepresented synthetic data

units.safety_or_ethics: No maximal testing, breath-holding, dehydration, deliberate exhaustion or unsupervised high-intensity protocols. This is conceptual physiology, not a personal training prescription. Stop activity for pain, dizziness, faintness or unusual breathing difficulty and tell a trusted adult.

units.title: Health information, epidemiology and evidence-based public-health reasoning
prerequisites: basic fractions, percentages and graph reading
learning_outcomes: distinguish incidence, prevalence, risk and rate in plain language
explain why population-level patterns do not predict an individual outcome
identify confounding, selection bias and measurement bias in a simple claim
compare relative and absolute risk statements
write a cautious evidence summary that separates observation from recommendation

units.safety_or_ethics: Educational evidence literacy only. Do not collect identifiable health information, diagnose anyone, recommend treatment or replace advice from qualified health professionals.

units.title: Training design: progression, load management and recovery
learning_outcomes: distinguish external workload from internal response
explain progressive overload, specificity, variation and recovery
design a conservative practice microcycle around an existing activity schedule
use a simple session reflection without treating it as medical measurement
identify when to reduce, modify or stop a session

units.safety_or_ethics: No maximal tests, unsupervised heavy lifting, forced weight targets or training through pain. Youth training should be age-appropriate and reviewed by a responsible adult/coach. Health concerns go to a qualified professional.

units.title: Game analysis: principles of play, constraints and performance review
prerequisites: ability to make a simple timeline or event log
learning_outcomes: analyse a team phase using width, depth, support, balance and penetration as contextual principles
distinguish tactical decision quality from execution outcome
code a small sample of game events consistently
identify how constraints change available decisions
produce a fair, evidence-based review with alternative explanations

units.title: Diction, articulation and expressive speech for an audience
learning_outcomes: distinguish articulation, diction, pace, phrasing and emphasis
adapt speech clarity to audience, room and recording conditions
use a controlled rehearsal loop to improve intelligibility
avoid over-articulation, forced accents and vocal strain
evaluate listener comprehension separately from personal preference

units.title: Performance production: rehearsal systems, recording and critique
prerequisites: basic file organisation and consent awareness
learning_outcomes: plan a short performance from brief to delivery
distinguish artistic intention from technical production constraints
capture usable audio/video with a simple repeatable setup
give and receive behaviour-specific critique

build a small spacing and layout system rather than arbitrary one-off values
explain responsive reflow and content priority across screen sizes
design reusable components with clear states

workflow_contract.assignment: ATHENA assigns objective, prerequisites, outcomes, source-quality expectations and evidence requirements.
workflow_contract.learning: Learner studies through independently selected external sources; ATHENA does not require all content to be taught in-app.
workflow_contract.evaluation: Evaluator assesses closed-book explanation, application, reasoning, provenance, uncertainty and safety.
workflow_contract.update: Evaluator may create a proposed update package; app validates and previews it.
workflow_contract.commit: Learner approval is mandatory; no automatic mastery or silent persistent update.
